name: Solana Delivery Bot
description: Autonomous delivery robot for warehouse and last-mile delivery operations

workflow.name: Initialize Scene
workflow.prompt:
Clear the Blender scene and set up for robot creation:

1. Delete all default objects (cube, camera, light)
2. Set units to Metric with scale 1.0
3. Create collections: 'Robot', 'Environment', 'Lights', 'Camera'
4. Add a ground plane (5m x 5m) at Z=0 with gray material
5. Set up three-point lighting:
   - Key light: Area light, 1000W at position (2, -2, 3)
   - Fill light: Area light, 500W at position (-2, -1, 2)
   - Rim light: Area light, 300W at position (0, 3, 2)
6. Add camera at (1.5, -1.5, 0.8) pointing at origin
7. Set render engine to Cycles with GPU if available
8. Set resolution to 1920x1080

workflow.name: Create Chassis
workflow.prompt:
Create the main robot chassis:

1. Add a cube and scale to 0.30m x 0.25m x 0.08m (width x depth x height)
2. Position at (0, 0, 0.05) so bottom is near ground
3. Add Bevel modifier with 0.005m width and 3 segments
4. Create wheel wells:
   - Add two cylinders (radius 0.045m, depth 0.03m) at X = ±0.12m
   - Boolean difference to create wheel cutouts
5. Add mounting hole pattern on top:
   - Grid of 6x4 small cylinders (radius 0.003m)
   - Boolean difference for holes
6. Create front sensor bracket:
   - Small extruded rectangle at front (0.08m x 0.02m x 0.015m)
7. Apply material:
   - Name: 'mat_chassis_dark_aluminum'
   - Base Color: RGB(0.15, 0.15, 0.18)
   - Metallic: 0.8
   - Roughness: 0.3
8. Name object: 'robot_chassis'
9. Move to 'Robot' collection

workflow.name: Create Drive Wheels
workflow.prompt:
Create the two main drive wheels:

For each wheel (left at X=-0.12m, right at X=0.12m):

1. Create tire:
   - Cylinder with radius 0.04m, depth 0.025m
   - Rotate 90° on Y axis
   - Position at (±0.12, 0, 0.04)
   - Add subdivision surface modifier (level 2)

2. Create tread pattern:
   - Add small cubes (0.008m x 0.003m x 0.005m)
   - Array modifier: 24 copies around circumference
   - Boolean union with tire

3. Create hub:
   - Cylinder radius 0.016m, depth 0.027m
   - Same position as tire
   - Add 5 curved spokes connecting to tire inner edge

4. Apply materials:
   - Tire: 'mat_rubber_black' - Color RGB(0.02, 0.02, 0.02), Metallic 0, Roughness 0.8
   - Hub: 'mat_aluminum_brushed' - Color RGB(0.6, 0.6, 0.62), Metallic 0.9, Roughness 0.4

5. Name objects: 'robot_wheel_left', 'robot_wheel_right'
6. Parent both wheels to 'robot_chassis'

workflow.name: Create Caster Wheels
workflow.prompt:
Create front and rear caster wheels for stability:

For each caster (front at Y=0.10m, rear at Y=-0.10m):

1. Create ball:
   - UV Sphere with radius 0.015m
   - Position at (0, ±0.10, 0.015)
   - Smooth shading

2. Create housing bracket:
   - Cube scaled to 0.025m x 0.02m x 0.025m
   - Position above ball
   - Add rounded edges

3. Create swivel mount:
   - Small cylinder connecting bracket to chassis
   - Radius 0.008m, height 0.015m

4. Apply materials:
   - Ball: 'mat_nylon_white' - Color RGB(0.9, 0.9, 0.92), Roughness 0.3
   - Bracket: 'mat_plastic_gray' - Color RGB(0.3, 0.3, 0.32), Roughness 0.5

5. Name objects: 'robot_caster_front', 'robot_caster_rear'
6. Parent to 'robot_chassis'

workflow.name: Create Depth Camera
workflow.prompt:
Create Intel RealSense style depth camera:

1. Create main housing:
   - Cube scaled to 0.09m x 0.025m x 0.025m
   - Position at (0, 0.13, 0.10)
   - Add slight bevel on edges

2. Create stereo camera lenses (left and right):
   - Two cylinders, radius 0.006m, depth 0.003m
   - Position at X = ±0.03m on front face
   - Add glass material for lens surface

3. Create IR projector:
   - Small dome/hemisphere in center
   - Radius 0.004m
   - Slight red tint material

4. Create RGB camera:
   - Small cylinder between stereo lenses
   - Radius 0.004m

5. Create mounting bracket:
   - L-shaped bracket on bottom
   - Screw hole details

6. Apply materials:
   - Housing: 'mat_realsense_silver' - Color RGB(0.7, 0.7, 0.72), Metallic 0.3, Roughness 0.25
   - Lenses: 'mat_glass_dark' - Transmission 0.9, Color RGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.15)

7. Name object: 'robot_camera_depth'
8. Parent to 'robot_chassis'

workflow.name: Create 2D LiDAR
workflow.prompt:
Create a 2D LiDAR scanner (puck style):

1. Create main housing:
   - Cylinder with radius 0.035m, height 0.05m
   - Position at (0, 0, 0.12)
   - This sits on top of chassis

2. Create rotating head:
   - Slightly smaller cylinder on top
   - Radius 0.033m, height 0.015m
   - Add visible seam line between base and head

3. Create optical window:
   - Thin cylinder band around head
   - Height 0.008m
   - Glossy black material for laser window

4. Create base details:
   - Cable exit port (small cylinder on side)
   - Mounting screw heads (4 small circles on bottom)
   - Status LED indicators (2 small dots)

5. Apply materials:
   - Housing: 'mat_lidar_black' - Color RGB(0.05, 0.05, 0.08), Metallic 0.1, Roughness 0.3
   - Window: 'mat_glass_black' - Color RGB(0.02, 0.02, 0.02), Roughness 0.1
   - LEDs: 'mat_led_green' - Emission strength 3.0, Color RGB(0, 1, 0.3)

6. Name object: 'robot_lidar_2d'
7. Parent to 'robot_chassis'

workflow.name: Create Ultrasonic Sensors
workflow.prompt:
Create two ultrasonic distance sensors at front corners:

For each sensor (left at X=-0.10m, right at X=0.10m):

1. Create PCB base:
   - Cube scaled to 0.045m x 0.02m x 0.002m
   - Position at (±0.10, 0.12, 0.06)
   - Green PCB material

2. Create transducers:
   - Two cylinders, radius 0.008m, depth 0.012m
   - Spaced 0.025m apart on PCB
   - Silver mesh material on front face

3. Add details:
   - Small components on PCB (rectangles for resistors)
   - Header pins on back edge
   - Mounting holes at corners

4. Apply materials:
   - PCB: 'mat_pcb_green' - Color RGB(0, 0.4, 0.2), Roughness 0.6
   - Transducers: 'mat_aluminum_mesh' - Color RGB(0.7, 0.7, 0.72), Metallic 0.8

5. Name objects: 'robot_ultrasonic_left', 'robot_ultrasonic_right'
6. Parent to 'robot_chassis'

workflow.name: Create Jetson Orin Nano
workflow.prompt:
Create NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano control unit:

1. Create carrier board PCB:
   - Cube scaled to 0.10m x 0.08m x 0.005m
   - Position at (0, -0.05, 0.09)
   - Inside chassis area

2. Create Jetson module:
   - Black rectangle on PCB: 0.07m x 0.045m x 0.008m
   - Centered on carrier board

3. Create heatsink:
   - On top of module: 0.065m x 0.04m x 0.015m
   - Add cooling fin detail (parallel ridges)
   - Add NVIDIA logo indent on top

4. Create ports along edges:
   - USB ports: 4 small rectangles (stacked pairs)
   - Ethernet RJ45: cube with clip detail
   - HDMI port: trapezoidal shape
   - Power barrel jack: cylinder

5. Create GPIO header:
   - 40-pin header (2 rows of 20)
   - Position on one edge

6. Apply materials:
   - PCB: 'mat_pcb_green' - Color RGB(0.05, 0.3, 0.1)
   - Module: 'mat_plastic_black' - Color RGB(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
   - Heatsink: 'mat_aluminum_silver' - Metallic 0.85, Roughness 0.3
   - Ports: various colors (USB blue, HDMI black, etc.)

7. Name object: 'robot_jetson_orin'
8. Parent to 'robot_chassis'

workflow.name: Create Battery Pack
workflow.prompt:
Create LiPo battery pack:

1. Create battery housing:
   - Cube with rounded corners: 0.15m x 0.05m x 0.025m
   - Position at (0, 0.02, 0.09)
   - Add safety radius on all edges

2. Create connectors:
   - Main discharge connector (XT60 style):
     - Yellow plastic housing
     - Position on one end
   - Balance connector:
     - Small white multi-pin connector
     - Position next to main connector

3. Create label area:
   - Slightly recessed rectangle on top
   - Add text: '22.2V 6S 5000mAh 50C'
   - Warning symbols

4. Create LED charge indicator:
   - Strip of 4 small LEDs
   - On side of battery

5. Apply materials:
   - Housing: 'mat_battery_shrink' - Color RGB(0.05, 0.05, 0.08), Roughness 0.4
   - XT60: 'mat_plastic_yellow' - Color RGB(0.9, 0.7, 0.1)
   - Balance: 'mat_plastic_white'

6. Name object: 'robot_battery_lipo'
7. Parent to 'robot_chassis'

workflow.name: Create LED Status Ring
workflow.prompt:
Create RGB LED status ring:

1. Create ring shape:
   - Torus with major radius 0.03m, minor radius 0.004m
   - Position at (0, 0, 0.15)
   - On top of LiDAR

2. Create LED segments:
   - 12 individual LED positions around ring
   - Small rectangular shapes
   - Slight gaps between segments

3. Create diffuser cover:
   - Slightly larger torus
   - Translucent white material
   - Covers LED segments

4. Create mounting base:
   - Thin disc below ring
   - Mounting holes

5. Apply materials:
   - LEDs: 'mat_led_cyan' - Emission strength 5.0, Color RGB(0, 0.7, 1.0)
   - Diffuser: 'mat_plastic_frosted' - Color RGB(0.95, 0.95, 0.98), Transmission 0.3
   - Base: 'mat_plastic_black'

6. Name object: 'robot_led_ring'
7. Parent to 'robot_chassis'

workflow.name: Create WiFi Antenna
workflow.prompt:
Create WiFi/Bluetooth antenna:

1. Create antenna paddle:
   - Flattened cube: 0.015m x 0.08m x 0.006m
   - Rounded top edge
   - Position at (0.08, -0.08, 0.10)
   - Rotate 15° outward

2. Create articulating base:
   - Small cylinder for pivot joint
   - Allows antenna to fold

3. Create SMA connector:
   - Gold-colored threaded cylinder
   - At bottom of antenna

4. Create internal element:
   - Visible through housing (slightly)
   - Thin wire pattern inside

5. Apply materials:
   - Paddle: 'mat_rubber_black' - Color RGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.1), Roughness 0.6
   - SMA: 'mat_gold' - Color RGB(0.83, 0.69, 0.22), Metallic 1.0

6. Name object: 'robot_antenna_wifi'
7. Parent to 'robot_chassis'

workflow.name: Add Branding and Details
workflow.prompt:
Add final branding and cosmetic details:

1. Add Solana logo on chassis sides:
   - Create gradient circle with Solana colors
   - Purple to cyan gradient
   - Position on both left and right sides
   - Size: 0.04m diameter

2. Add 'SOLANA ROBOTICS' text:
   - Embossed or decal on top of chassis
   - Font: Bold sans-serif
   - Color: Light gray or white

3. Add reflective safety strips:
   - Thin strips around base perimeter
   - Reflective orange/yellow material
   - Emission strength 0.5 for visibility

4. Add rubber bumper:
   - Thin rubber strip around chassis edge
   - Height 0.01m
   - Protects from collisions

5. Add charging port:
   - Small rectangular recess at rear
   - Barrel jack or USB-C port visible
   - Rubber cover flap

6. Add serial number plate:
   - Small metal plate
   - 'SRK-001' engraved

7. Apply final materials and check all normals
8. Ensure all objects are properly parented to chassis

workflow.name: Final Assembly Check
workflow.prompt:
Perform final assembly verification:

1. Select all robot objects:
   - Verify all are in 'Robot' collection
   - Check parent hierarchy (all parented to chassis)

2. Check object origins:
   - Chassis origin at center bottom
   - Wheels origin at center for rotation
   - Set origins appropriately for animation

3. Apply transformations:
   - Select all robot objects
   - Apply rotation and scale (Ctrl+A)

4. Verify materials:
   - Check all objects have materials assigned
   - No missing textures or broken links

5. Check geometry:
   - No overlapping faces
   - No inverted normals
   - Clean mesh topology

6. Position robot:
   - Wheels touching ground plane
   - Centered at origin

7. Create render preview:
   - Frame robot in camera
   - Test render at low samples
   - Verify lighting and shadows look correct

8. Save Blender file:
   - File > Save As
   - Name: 'solana_delivery_bot.blend'
